vision.notation: Image content part BEFORE the text part (model-card best practice).

notes: Requires llama-server started with --jinja and a chat template (the canonical Gemma 4 template needs the minja 'is iterable' patch). Thinking emits <|channel>thought … <channel|> blocks — strip on the closer <channel|> before extracting output; the empty channel is emitted even when thinking is OFF. When thinking is on, add the budget (+2048) to max_tokens. VLM: vision token budget is startup-only (--image-min-tokens/--image-max-tokens, locked 1120) and needs --ubatch-size 2048.
